guide.simple_bytestorage_scripting.intro:
§eSimpleAE: Scripting§r adds two blocks:
- §bLogic Bus§r runs a JavaScript script.
- §bLogic Terminal§r edits scripts of all Logic Buses in the network.

§eSteps§r
1. Connect the Terminal and the Buses to the network.
2. Put a Bus next to an inventory (chest, machine).
3. Right-click the Terminal, pick a Bus on the left, write the script, press §bSave§r, then §bRun§r.

Saving stops the bus: press Run to start it. The §b-§r/§b+§r buttons change the interval (ticks between runs). Status and log are shown below the editor. Any error or exceeded limit stops the bus and shows the reason.

The script top level runs once; §bfunction tick()§r is called every interval. Global variables survive between runs (but not a world reload).
guide.simple_bytestorage_scripting.api.b:
Items are strings: §b"minecraft:iron_ingot"§r (NBT is ignored).

§eNetwork§r
§bnet.count(id)§r - how many
§bnet.has(id, n)§r - at least n?
§bnet.list()§r - [{slot,id,count}]
§bnet.usedBytes()§r, §bnet.freeBytes()§r
§bnet.craft(id, n)§r - order autocrafting, returns accepted crafts

§eInventories§r
§bside("up")§r - neighbour on that side (down/up/north/south/west/east) or null
endpoint methods:
§bslots()§r, §blist()§r, §bcount(id)§r
§bpull([id], [n])§r - inventory -> network
§bpush(id, [n])§r - network -> inventory
§bmove(other, [id], [n])§r - inventory -> another endpoint
They return how many items were moved.

§eOther§r
§blog(...)§r - write to the terminal log
§btime()§r - game time in ticks

Standard JS (Math, JSON, arrays, strings) works. Java is not accessible.
guide.simple_bytestorage_scripting.admin:
Config: §bconfig/simple_bytestorage_scripting-common.toml§r

§benabled§r - master switch (false stops all buses)
§bopsOnly§r - only operators (level 2+) and the singleplayer owner can edit/run scripts
§ballowCrafting§r - allow net.craft
§bmaxScriptLength§r, §bminInterval§r
§bmaxInstructionsPerRun§r, §bmaxMillisPerRun§r
§bmaxItemsPerRun§r, §bmaxApiCallsPerRun§r

§eSandbox§r: scripts have no access to Java, files or network, and are limited by instructions, time, items and API calls per run.

§6Note:§r there is no memory limit. On public servers enable §bopsOnly§r.

Without the addon jar, these blocks do not exist.
